bento.title: Built for citizen truth, not approximations
bento.desc: How SWATVA combines versioned statutory rulebooks, zero-retention OCR lockers, and natural language explanation.
bento.card1Desc: Eligibility is computed against structured logic trees codified directly from gazette notifications. Zero hallucination — every verdict cites the exact statutory condition.
bento.card3Desc: Extract and check mandatory fields from Aadhaar, Income Certificates, and Land Records once. No unconsented storage.
bento.card4Desc: Describe family circumstances in your mother tongue. SWATVA's multilingual pipeline translates everyday problems into exact statutory criteria.

steps.title: From nothing to applying
steps.desc: No forms to guess at. SWATVA reads the scheme rules, checks them against your profile, and tells you exactly what to do next.
steps.item0Body: Age, income, state, occupation, category, disability status and household. Takes about two minutes, and you can stop and resume at any point.
steps.item1Body: Every active scheme is evaluated against your profile and returned as eligible, not eligible, or missing information — each with the exact condition that decided it.
steps.item2Body: For each match you get a step-by-step checklist, the documents it needs, and a readiness score that tells you whether you are actually able to submit today.

capabilities.title: Built around the whole application, not just the search
capabilities.desc: Finding a scheme is the easy half. SWATVA covers the documents, the readiness and the paperwork that decide whether you actually receive the benefit.
capabilities.item0Body: Eligibility is decided by stored eligibility rules, never by a language model. Every verdict is reproducible and cites the condition that produced it.
capabilities.item1Body: Aggregates the annual value of everything you qualify for but have not claimed, so the cost of not applying is a number rather than a suspicion.
capabilities.item2Body: Upload a document once, validate it against the scheme requirement, correct extracted fields, and reuse it across every scheme that needs it.
capabilities.item3Body: Per-scheme readiness scoring across the documents and steps still outstanding, so you know which applications are genuinely submittable.
capabilities.item4Body: Describe a life event in Hindi or English and get the schemes it unlocked, with citations back to the official scheme text.
capabilities.item5Body: Read how much each department disbursed, how long applications take, and report problems back through the same surface.

trust.title: An LLM should not decide what you are owed
trust.body: A wrong answer about a pension is not a small mistake — it is a family waiting on money that never arrives. So SWATVA keeps the decision and the language model strictly apart.
trust.point0Body: Matches come from versioned scheme rules. When a language model is available it only rewrites the outcome in plain language, and the response is labelled as deterministic.
trust.point1Title: Missing is not the same as no
trust.point1Body: A blank profile field produces a missing-information outcome, never a silent rejection. The system asks instead of guessing.
trust.point2Body: Each match lists the conditions it satisfied, the ones it failed, and the information it still needs.
trust.point3Body: If the model or the vector store is unavailable, SWATVA falls back to keyword retrieval and rule-based explanations rather than inventing an answer.

coverage.title: Twenty schemes, verified against official sources
coverage.desc: Every scheme carries its official source URL, its raw published text, its document requirements, its application steps and the date it was last verified.

faq.title: Before you ask
faq.a0: Yes. The code, the catalogue and the rules are open. You never need to pay anyone to find out what you qualify for, and a broker who claims otherwise is misleading you.
faq.q1: Do I need an Aadhaar number to start?
faq.a1: No. Build a profile with the basics and add documents later. Aadhaar is needed for some schemes at the application stage, not for discovery.
faq.q2: How current is the scheme data?
faq.a2: Each scheme records a lastVerifiedAt date and links to its official government source. The catalogue is seeded from those sources rather than written from memory.
faq.a3: The interface and assistant work in English and Hindi.
faq.a4: They are stored against your own account, used only to check scheme requirements, and you can delete any of them at any time.
